narration:0:1460470001:0.text: You return to the clinic, a little tired after a day of chasing hyper kids around in circles.
narration:0:1460470001:0.source_cn: 你回到了医馆，围着大呼小叫的孩子们打转的一天让你有些疲倦。

narration:1:1460470002:0.text: Thinking about the childrens' symptoms gives you a few ideas. But for now, you're still missing the herbs you'd need to test them out.
narration:1:1460470002:0.source_cn: 想到孩子们的情况，你产生了一些灵感，但目前的药材，似乎...

narration:2:1460470003:0.text: Not long after, Xera returns to the clinic...
narration:2:1460470003:0.source_cn: 不久之后，席蕾也回到了医馆……
